config.server.preview_hint: Off by default. Use a separate site with wildcard DNS and TLS. Test app logins, files and WebSockets on staged hosts before enabling.
config.server.trusted_proxy_cidrs_hint: Enter the immediate reverse proxy IP addresses or CIDR ranges, separated by commas or new lines. Other sources cannot supply forwarded headers.
config.server.cert_auto_notice: Automatic certificates via Let's Encrypt. Requires a publicly reachable domain and ports 80/443.
config.server.cert_custom_notice: Use your own TLS certificate files (PEM format). You can upload them below or specify file paths.
config.server.cert_regen_success: Self-signed certificate regenerated. Restart to apply.
config.server.cert_selfsigned_domain_hin: Used as Subject Alternative Name in the certificate.
config.server.cert_selfsigned_notice: A self-signed certificate will be auto-generated. Browsers will show a security warning.
config.server.cert_upload_missing: Please select both a certificate and a key file.
config.server.cert_upload_success: Certificate uploaded successfully. Restart to apply.
config.server.https_desc: Enable HTTPS with automatic, custom, or self-signed certificates. Works independently of other settings.
config.server.https_disabled_desc: Many Desktop features, especially voice chat and microphone access, may fail over HTTP. HTTPS through a reverse proxy and localhost can still provide a secure browser context.
config.server.oauth_redirect_hint: Override base URL for OAuth callbacks (e.g. when behind reverse proxy).
config.server.selfsigned_port_warning: Port below 1024 requires root/admin privileges on Linux/macOS. For local access without elevated privileges, use port 8443 instead.
config.server.disable_https_confirm: This only changes your draft. Save and restart AuraGo to use HTTP. HSTS rules from a proxy or parent domain may still enforce HTTPS.
config.server.http_port_hint: 0 disables the HTTP listener. For Let’s Encrypt HTTP-01, select 80 and make public port 80 reachable.
config.server.confirm_regen_message: The current certificate is replaced by a new one. Browsers and clients that trusted the old certificate show a security warning again until they accept the new one, and open HTTPS connections may be interrupted.
config.server.host_hint: Network address AuraGo listens on. Empty or 0.0.0.0 = all interfaces, 127.0.0.1 = this machine only. A restart is required after changing it.
config.server.port_hint: TCP port of the web UI and API (default 8088). A restart is required after changing it.
config.server.ui_language_hint: Language of the web UI and system messages. Applies to every user of this instance.
config.server.cert_mode_hint: Where the TLS certificate comes from: automatic via Let's Encrypt, your own files, or a self-signed certificate for local testing.
config.server.https_port_hint: Port for encrypted connections (default 443). Ports below 1024 need root rights or a matching capability on Linux.
config.server.domain_hint: Public domain name the certificate is issued for. It must point to this server.
config.server.email_hint: Contact address for Let's Encrypt, for example for expiry warnings. It is only sent to the certificate authority.
config.server.cert_file_hint: Path to the certificate file in PEM format, relative to the AuraGo directory or absolute.
config.server.key_file_hint: Path to the private key in PEM format. The file should be readable by the AuraGo account only.
config.server.behind_proxy_hint: Turn on when a reverse proxy terminates TLS. Only addresses in the list below may set forwarded headers. If set wrongly, client addresses can be spoofed.
